package left

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/datatable"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"
)

var audit http.Middleware

func helperNil(capability bool) ([]http.GuardOption[User], error) {
	if !capability {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return []http.GuardOption[User]{http.Permissions(viewer)}, nil
}

func useHelperNil() {
	opts, err := helperNil(true)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	_ = datatable.ReadAccess(opts...)
}

func reassigned() {
	member := []http.GuardOption[User]{http.Permissions(viewer)}
	member = append(member, http.Scopes(read))
	_ = http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, member...)
}

func usedElsewhere() {
	member := []http.GuardOption[User]{http.Permissions(viewer)}
	_ = len(member)
	_ = http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, member...)
}

func bothDeclare() {
	member := []http.GuardOption[User]{http.Permissions(viewer)}
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read)))
	_ = http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, member...)
}

func withActor() {
	member := []http.GuardOption[User]{http.Permissions(viewer), http.ActorMiddleware[User](audit)}
	_ = http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, member...)
}

func empty() {
	member := []http.GuardOption[User]{}
	_ = http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, member...)
}

func asValue() {
	f := valueHelper
	_ = f
}

func valueHelper() []http.GuardOption[User] {
	return []http.GuardOption[User]{http.Permissions(viewer)}
}
